evals.name: seedream55-chinese-poster
evals.prompt: 用 seedream-image-gen 的默认 Seedream 5.5 生成2K横版海报，准确写“新绿计划”，奶油白和青绿色，清晰无衬线标题，不加其他文字或水印。保存图片和元数据。
evals.expected_output: One PNG and metadata identifying the dated Seedream 5.5 model; visible title is checked manually.

assertions.name: required text is accurate
assertions.description: The required Chinese characters are visually correct; do not replace visual inspection with an HTTP200 assertion.

evals.name: keyless-preserving-dry-run
evals.prompt: 在不含.env且不配置ARK_API_KEY的临时目录运行批量dry-run；另用generate/edit --dry-run --force指向已有图片，确认旧元数据逐字节保持不变。
evals.expected_output: Batch payload preview succeeds without credentials; existing metadata stays intact and new preview metadata can still be created.

assertions.name: metadata preserved
assertions.description: Existing image/JSON bytes remain unchanged even with --force.

evals.name: unknown-and-download-retries
evals.prompt: 用离线HTTP桩模拟生成POST超时，以及生成成功后下载GET重试耗尽。检查不会自动重发可能已计费的POST。
evals.expected_output: OutcomeUnknown stops after one POST; download retries remain GET-only and report DownloadFailed after exhaustion.

assertions.name: no uncertain replay
assertions.description: POST count stays one after a transport timeout.

assertions.name: download remains cheap
assertions.description: GET retry exhaustion never re-enters generation.

evals.name: text-to-rgba
evals.prompt: 默认模型从文字生成透明背景的“新绿 STUDIO”标志，下载PNG并检查Alpha。
evals.expected_output: Uses 5.5 without an input image, background transparent and PNG; inspect real alpha and text.

assertions.name: usable artifact
assertions.description: Uses 5.5 without an input image, background transparent and PNG; inspect real alpha and text.

evals.name: rgb-to-rgba
evals.prompt: 把普通RGB商品照片中的杯子直接提取成透明PNG。
evals.expected_output: 5.5 direct edit, without requiring preexisting alpha or mandatory decomposition; inspect contours.

assertions.name: usable artifact
assertions.description: 5.5 direct edit, without requiring preexisting alpha or mandatory decomposition; inspect contours.

evals.name: ocr-localize
evals.prompt: 拆分一张英文海报，保留富文本OCR；利用文字行坐标和本地字体把标题改成中文，不调用第二次生图。
evals.expected_output: 5.5 decompose with max_images 2–100 and text_recognition true; preserve OCR in layers.json, omit old title layer and typeset local replacement in base-coordinate bbox; disclose font approximation.

assertions.name: usable artifact
assertions.description: 5.5 decompose with max_images 2–100 and text_recognition true; preserve OCR in layers.json, omit old title layer and typeset local replacement in base-coordinate bbox; disclose font approximation.

evals.name: single-supported-model
evals.prompt: 在离线临时目录尝试 --model pro、--model flash、旧版完整 model_id 和任意未知 ID；再试一次 --model 5.5。
evals.expected_output: Only 5.5 resolves. Every other model fails before an API call, with no silent substitution.

assertions.name: no legacy submission
assertions.description: Old and unknown model IDs are rejected; the default and 5.5 alias both resolve to doubao-seedream-5-5-261028.

evals.name: exact-small-output
evals.prompt: 使用 Seedream 5.5 生成1500x600咖啡壶封面，左侧留白、右侧产品，不要人或文字。保存最终图片和元数据。
evals.expected_output: One exact 1500x600 PNG, generated at a valid larger native size and locally downscaled.

assertions.name: exact dimensions
assertions.description: Decoded image and metadata both retain the requested 1500x600 destination.
